data.name: Mini Heroes: Squad Online
data.detailed_description:
Jump into fast-paced 2D online arena battles where squads of up to four players fight for supremacy in a single action-packed arena!

Key Features

  • 4-Player Online PvP: Create your room, join a friend’s room with a room name, or hop into Quick Match and dive straight into the action.

  • Over 20 Weapons: Choose from rifled assault rifles, explosive miniguns, sniper rifles and more for high-octane, chaotic combat.

  • Single Floating Arena: A vibrant, cartoon-style platform battlefield floating in the sky. No clutter, just pure, intense 4-way warfare.

  • Character & Weapon Customization: Dress up your hero in bold outfits and unlock cosmetic skins for weapons to show your style, not your wallet.

  • Leaderboards & Rankings: Climb the global rankings and prove you’re the ultimate Mini Hero.

  • Free Create & Join Mechanics: Whether you prefer starting your own room or dropping into a public match, we’ve got you.

  • Monetized for Fun, Not Advantage: Earn in-game currency and spend it on cosmetics; no pay-to-win mechanics. Skills matter.

Why It’s a Blast

Mini Heroes: Squad Online fuses the visual charm of 2D platform shooters with the competitive pulse of modern online arena combat. With just one rich arena and up to four players, you’ll get rapid, replayable action every session. Pick your weapon, choose your customization, and let the mayhem begin.

Because we kept the scoreboard tight and the action direct, there’s no downtime, no confusing maps—just pure fast-paced duels, fiery minigun sprays, sniper headshots, and squad-based rivalries. The cosmetics let you stand out visually, the ranked system lets you stand out skill-wise.

Perfect for Fans of

  • Online multiplayer shooters

  • 2D platform combat

  • Party games

  • Quick-match chaos

  • Competitive co-op vs co-op

If you’ve ever shouted “room name, ready up, GO!” with friends—this is your arena. Invite up to three buddies (or fill the fourth slot with top-tier rivals), pick from more than 20 weapons, hit the floating platform, and let bullets fly. Leaderboards await the top squads, cosmetics await your victory.

Mini Heroes: Squad Online isn’t your ordinary shooter; it’s a vibrant, accessible online battle game for everyone — packed with weapons, style, and instant fun. Create or join a room, grab your gear, jump into the arena, and find out: who’s the hero?

Get ready to jump in, gear up, and rise to the top.

Minimum:

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

  • Storage: 150 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Intel i3 (2015 or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 / Iris or newer, or Apple Silicon)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
